## Objective

Describe the goal of this feature.

## Context

Explain why this feature is needed and what problem it solves.

## Tasks

- [ ] Define the implementation approach.
- [ ] Implement the feature.
- [ ] Validate the expected behavior.
- [ ] Update documentation if necessary.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The feature meets the agreed requirements.
- [ ] Relevant functionality is manually validated.
- [ ] Applicable lint, build, and tests pass.
- [ ] Responsive and accessible behavior is considered where relevant.
- [ ] Changes are delivered through a Pull Request.

## Additional Notes

Add dependencies, design references, screenshots, or relevant links.
